facts.text: I am thinking of making a matching hat to go with a scarf I just made for my sister's birthday.
My sister's birthday was last weekend.
I used soft, pastel pink yarn for the scarf.
I will stick with soft, pastel pink yarn for the hat.
I cannot try the hat on my sister before giving it to her.
I finished making a scarf for my sister's birthday last weekend.
I added a tassel at the end of the scarf.
I am using soft, pastel pink yarn for the hat.
I will use US Size 7 (4.5mm) aluminum straight needles.
I have worked with US Size 7 (4.5mm) aluminum straight needles before.
I am considering adding embellishments to the hat, such as a pom-pom or a small flower.
I want to add a small, soft pom-pom in a matching pastel pink color to the hat.
I am considering adding a small, subtle label or tag to the hat with my sister's initials or name.
I will add a small, hand-embroidered label with my sister's initials.
I will keep the font simple and the label small so it does not overpower the hat.
I am wondering whether blocking is necessary for a hat after I finish knitting it.
